svg.aria-label: Nephron sites and the drugs that act there
svg.title: Nephron sites

g.text: Proximal tubule — most reabsorption. Carbonic anhydrase. SGLT2. Acetazolamide.
Thick ascending limb — NKCC2. Diluting segment. Loop diuretics. Impermeable to water.
Distal convoluted tubule — NCC. Thiazides. Calcium reabsorption rises.
Collecting duct — ENaC and aldosterone, aquaporins and ADH, acid secretion.

svg.text: Mechanism map. Doses and when to start a drug are Step 2 and Step 3 decisions.
